alt: Real ChatGPT /flashcard execution: fast prompt entry, sending, accelerated generation and normal-speed widget use.
caption: New temporary chat → PDF → shortcut → generation → extended widget use
prompt: /flashcard Using only the attached chapter, create three interactive flashcards on tokens, context and probability versus truth. Include answer reveal, next/back and progress. Answer in English.
setupPrompt: Use the attached chapter as the only source for the next activity. Please wait for my next request.

phases.name: upload
phases.caption: Start a new temporary chat and attach the chapter PDF.

phases.name: setup-generation
phases.caption: ChatGPT reads the uploaded chapter · accelerated.

phases.name: typing
phases.caption: Write the shortcut request as the second message.

phases.name: send
phases.caption: Send the second message containing the shortcut.

phases.name: widget
phases.caption: View the generated flashcards before starting the review.

phases.name: usage
phases.caption: Review the flashcards at normal speed.

actions.label: Recall the first answer, then flip the card to check it.
Flip back to the question and try recalling the distinction again.
Reveal the answer again before marking your recall.
Mark this distinction as known and move to card two.
Read the context question, reveal the answer, and compare it with the chapter.
Mark this card as needing more practice.
Reveal the third answer about probability versus truth.
Finish the three-card review and inspect the learning summary.
Retry only the missed card instead of restarting the whole deck.
Recall the difficult distinction, then reveal its explanation again.
Finish the targeted retry and inspect the new result.

deliveryNormalization.method: Aspect-preserving Lanczos downsample from 1664x1040 to 1440x900. H.264 CRF14; original 60 fps cadence and duration preserved. Native media retained in the ignored pre-pull review archive.
